description: PROVINCIA SONDRIO - VIABILITA PRINCIPALE is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by provinciasondrio.it. Graph provincial and state roads of the province of Sondrio, derived from the topographic database and updated as a result of changes in road conditions. The Province of Sondrio displays the WMS services of all information levels that can be viewed from its Geoportal at this address:. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PROVINCE SONDRIO - MAIN VIABILITY" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include strade provinciali, reti per la mobilità, strade, viabilità, cippi, pianificazione. The listing shows 2024-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
